 The Best Dallas Restaurants for Thanksgiving Dinner or Brunch
 From a Feast Atop Reunion Tower to a Brand-New Michelin-Recognized Indian Spot, Dine Out in Style This Turkey Day
 By Megan Ziots 
// Oct 27, 2026 
 Save Article 
 1 / 0 
 For the first time since opening, Crown Block is hosting a Thanksgiving Day Feast atop Reunion Tower. (Courtesy of Crown Block)
 Jashan is new Indian fine dining restaurant at The Shops at Legacy East in Plano. (Courtesy)
 From noon to 9 pm on November 26, The Dining Room at The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas, is hosting an indulgent "Thanksgiving Mercato" experience featuring holiday specials and culinary stations. (Courtesy)
 W e love that more and more people have gotten on board with the idea that Thanksgiving doesn’t have to mean spending all day in the kitchen. It’s sometimes easier to enjoy a meal (especially a holiday meal) with the family when the work part is taken out of the equation. There’s usually less bickering, too. I’m looking at you, Dad.
 So, on that note, we’ve rounded up some of our favorite local dining concepts doing the hard work for you this year. From a feast atop the Reunion Tower to a different kind of Turkey Day at a brand-new Michelin-recognized Indian spot, these are our top Dallas restaurants for Thanksgiving brunch or dinner.
 Fearing’s Restaurant
 Uptown 
 2121 McKinney Avenue
Dallas, TX 75201  |   Map 
 214-922-4848 
 Website 
 Chef Dean Fearing's namesake restaurant is located at The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas. (Courtesy)
 Michelin-recommended Fearing’s is serving up Thanksgiving lunch and dinner from 11 am to 3 pm and 5 pm to 8:30 pm on November 26. For $160 per person ($55 for kids), the three-course prix fixe menu will include a choice of seasonal starters, entrées including traditional turkey, seafood, and steak selections, and a festive dessert presentation.
 Make sure to check out The Ritz-Carlton Dallas’ Holiday Tea this season as well.
 Catch Dallas
 Uptown 
 3005 Maple Avenue
Dallas, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 Enjoy Thanksgiving at CATCH Dallas this year. The seafood spot will be offering exclusive holiday specials. (Courtesy of CATCH)
 Enjoy Thanksgiving at CATCH Dallas on November 26 from 3:30 pm to 8:30 pm with holiday specials alongside its regular menu. Highlights include the Short Rib Croquette ($18), Roasted Heritage Turkey ($60), served with herbed stuffing, mashed potatoes, caramelized vegetables, turkey gravy, and cranberry sauce, as well as the Pumpkin Spice Gelato Sundae ($18).
 The Adolphus
 Downtown 
 1321 Commerce Street
Dallas, TX  |   Map 
 The Adolphus hotel hosts elegant brunches for holidays during the year. (Courtesy)
 On November 26, Thanksgiving kicks off at The Adolphus hotel starting at 11:30 am. For $145 per adult ($50 for kids), a ticket to the buffet includes a complimentary glass of sparkling wine and valet parking. Guests can expect a raw bar, carving station, specialty desserts, and more.
 St. Martin’s Wine Bistro
 East Dallas 
 4223 Bryan Street
Dallas, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 The new St. Martin's space features black-and-white checkerboard floors, chandeliers, and a piano — retaining the classic charm of the original while offering a refreshed feel. (Courtesy)
 A Dallas classic, St. Martin’s Wine Bistro is hosting a Thanksgiving plate (and desserts) for dinner on November 26, alongside its regular menu. For $55 per person, the special holiday plate will include turkey, dressing, haricots verts casserole, and other traditional trimmings. Desserts will include pumpkin soufflé, pumpkin pie, and chocolate-pecan pie.
 Providing the ambiance, there will be live piano music.
 Jashan Indian Fine Dining
 Plano 
 7401 Lone Star Drive, Suite B 120
Plano, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 Jashan is new Indian fine dining restaurant at The Shops at Legacy East in Plano. (Courtesy)
 A brand-new addition to the Michelin Guide Texas this year, Jashan is an Indian fine-dining restaurant at The Shops at Legacy East in Plano. If you’re looking for something different for Thanksgiving this year for the family, the new spot is offering a prix fixe menu for four people for $250 from November 25 through November 27. The regular menu will also be available.
 Crown Block
 Downtown 
 300 Reunion Boulevard
Dallas, TX 75207  |   Map 
 Website 
 For the first time since opening, Crown Block is hosting a Thanksgiving Day Feast atop Reunion Tower. (Courtesy)
 For the first time since opening, Crown Block is hosting a Thanksgiving Day Feast atop Reunion Tower. The Michelin-recommended steakhouse will prepare an all-you-can-eat buffet for $165 per person, available from 11 am to 6 pm on November 26. This includes a carving station, sides like green bean casserole, cornbread dressing, truffled deviled eggs, maple-glazed sweet potatoes, and more, sushi, seafood, desserts, and so much more.
 TVs will also be stationed around the buffet so guests can still enjoy Game Day. If you’re looking to celebrate early, on November 22, Crown Block is hosting a Thanksgiving-themed brunch from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm, featuring an $80 per person buffet and à la carte options.
 Alára
 Design District 
 1628 Oak Lawn Avenue, Suite 120
Dallas, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 Now open in Dallas' Design District, Alara is a new Mediterranean restaurant from Chef Onur Akan. (Courtesy of Alara)
 New to the Dallas Design District, this modern Mediterranean restaurant from Chef Onur Akan is offering a special five-course prix-fixe menu on November 25 and 27 (not on Thanksgiving Day). For $125 per person, the holiday menu will feature seasonal dishes with a Mediterranean twist like the Caramelized Butternut Squash Ravioli, Turkey Roulade, and Turkish Coffee-Crusted Hanger Steak. Dessert options include the Chocolate Lava Cake or a Wine-Poached Apple. Vegan and gluten-free options will also be available. This menu is reservation-only, and the restaurant’s regular menu will be offered on both days.
 Stillwell’s
 Harwood District 
 2575 McKinnon Street
Dallas, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 Stillwell's uses in-house beef program, Harwood Premium Beef, for their cuts. (Photo by Samantha Marie)
 This Michelin-recommended steakhouse at Hotel Swexan is also hosting a special Thanksgiving Dinner on November 26. Alongside its signature dishes, Stillwell’s will feature the holiday exclusive: Turkey Roulade, served with stuffing, butterscotch heirloom carrots, spiced Texas pecans, classic gravy, and cranberry mostard.
 HALL Arts Hotel
 Downtown 
 1717 Leonard Street
Dallas, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 Earlier this year, ASTRA debuted as HALL Arts Hotel's signature restaurant. (Courtesy)
 On November 26, ASTRA Kitchen + Lounge at HALL Arts Hotel is hosting a Thanksgiving Dinner from 3 pm to 10 pm. For $85 per person, the prix fixe menu will feature dishes like roasted pumpkin bisque, Southwest turkey roulade with cornbread stuffing and jalapeño cranberry sauce, and grilled filet mignon. For dessert, there will be bites like sweet potato creme brûlée and pecan pie.
 The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas
 Irving 
 4150 N. MacArthur Boulevard
Las Colinas, TX  |   Map 
 Website 
 From noon to 9 pm on November 26, The Dining Room at The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas, is hosting an indulgent "Thanksgiving Mercato" experience featuring holiday specials and culinary stations. (Courtesy)
 From noon to 9 pm on November 26, The Dining Room at The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas, is hosting an indulgent “Thanksgiving Mercato” experience featuring holiday specials and culinary stations. For $155 per adult ($55 for kids), the buffet includes highlights like a Cacio e Pepe cheese wheel, an herb-roasted turkey carving station, and hand-carved prime rib.
